annotations.description: With Riverpyre Verge in hand and only Mountains, playing a Mountain on turn 1 means Riverpyre Verge will only tap for {R} on future turns (since it needs an Island or Mountain to tap for {U}). Playing Riverpyre Verge now costs nothing since they want to cast Burnout Bashtronaut ({R}) this turn anyway, and it preserves flexibility for future land drops. With only red cards in hand currently, this is a very minor issue, but Riverpyre Verge played first is strictly better sequencing - it taps for {R} regardless, and playing a Mountain first gives no additional benefit while consuming a basic that could be more useful later (e.g., if they draw cards needing {U}, having already established Riverpyre Verge with a Mountain in play enables the {U} ability).
